notes.title: 80K Wishlists, Demo update and NorthernLion! Shroom and Gloom Aug 2025 Dev Log!
notes.content:
[p]Yo Shroomers!

It's been more than a month since we last updated the demo for Shroom and Gloom, our fungal-punk, first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder. Today we're stoked as heck to check in with our August dev log, and share the news that we've just dropped a toasty update to our demo, hit a milestone on our wishlists, and got picked up by your (most likely) favourite streamer![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/476eb899493dca2a85cafd3a90d8cdc2c1c2daca.jpg"][/img]
[b]Demo Update! [/b] After our last update we said we'd be taking a break from patching the demo so we could get back to our main quest our working on the full game. That's just what we did, digging back into the cards and environments that players will be able to enjoy in the final, super-sized Shroom and Gloom.  

But, as the weeks rolled by, we found we were landing wins that would have meant the demo could be greatly improved. As the demo continued getting positive attention, we started experimenting with making some new beta builds and preparing to drop yet another update to the demo.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/078e45eb5e3eb16936687c3c4cc5be67ece78ef9.jpg"][/img]Today, we're delighted to share that the update is live! You can play Shroom and Gloom 0.4.75 right now! From the visual overhaul of levels, to improved handling of cards in your hand, to the redesign of the cards themselves, pretty much every corner of the demo is improved. For a full list of changes, stick around for the end of this dev log!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/dc13dc4cda5db1acd6d394e81aad2cc1ef159ce7.jpg"][/img][b]80K Wishlists! [/b] Not much to say here, aside from;  HUGE HIGH FIVES EVERYONE! We're delighted to share that Shroom and Gloom has now been wishlisted more than 80 000 times!  

Our greatest thanks to every single one of the 80K people that have given Shroom and Gloom your stamp of approval. It's endlessly encouraging to us that so many good people want this game in their lives!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/fe2d1f146b9c65c8458c839595313bb20f0f5f01.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NorthernLion enjoys mushroom sauce![/b] [/p][p]Ever since we first revealed the Shroom and Gloom prototype we started recieving comments like "NorthernLion gonna love this" or "The Egg needs this game" or "New NL favourite just dropped." Less than 1 year into development, we're stoked to share that this roguelike hero picked up on the demo!
[/p][previewyoutube="HW5VjZew8-0;full"][/previewyoutube][p] It seemed like the game was really well received by NL and his lovely community. This delighted existing members of our Gloom Patrol, and brought a whole new wave of dungeon crawlers in the fold! If you happen to have been one of them, please thank NL for sending you our way! Great to have you along for the ride as we bring this game into the world![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/ca55f006014b4941d4f2d1d112ddbe7415c774b0.jpg"][/img][b]Okay, bye![/b] [/p][p]That's all for us this month! Hope ya'll have a wonderful time with the updated demo! Don't be a stranger and let us know what you think of all the improvements!  Stay rad everybody! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/ff9dc4d39726577af31ddfd20ba22b553344d3dd.png"][/img][b]Main changes and improvements to the demo since our last update:
[/b]
[b]Visuals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve added flies and spiders![/p][/*][*][p]Mega environmental improvements across all tunnels. Includes improved lighting, post processing, new mushrooms![/p][/*][*][p]Gloom World glow up! Enjoy even more crystalized eye candy if you can beat the demo![/p][/*][*][p]New doors and door frames leading into special environments (mossy, thorny or trippy). Enjoy clearer choices while exploring![/p][/*][*][p]New biome-specific plinths for deploying your camp structures on![/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mega re-design of card UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Card descriptions separated based on when a card behavior will take effect (activated, triggered or passive). Added icons to make this clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom card bases to indicate deck type (combat, explore, curse, forsight or shroom)[/p][/*][*][p]Custom banners to indicate card classes (attack, skill, search, food, passive, curse or foresight)[/p][/*][*][p]Card status (like evolve, uses or battery) moved from bottom of card to little scrolls, in the top right.[/p][/*][*][p]Targeting pips on top of cards to indicate if they will effect 1 enemy, all enemies, 1 card, all cards in hand or the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Unique "toppings" for cards that can only be found in specific biomes (mossy or thorny)[/p][/*][*][p]Card artworks now dynamic. Will reposition if extra rules are added to cards by players.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to the description being split into 3, cards should now better adjust layout as they grow, without text going off the edge of the card. (it's still possible, but we are not sure if it’s realistic to do it in a single run.)[/p][/*][*][p]Small change to the cost of a card in a shop, showing it in the top right.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UX:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Major rework to how cards behave in the players hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Cards lift to the bottom of the screen when being cast and to an equal height when highlighted.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues where highlighted cards could jitter when holding large amounts of cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed card sorting in hand. Feedback was that sorting made it difficult to identify new cards. Will add a sorting toggle in future.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved deck view, which allows you to toggle between draw pile and all cards![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The map has been fixed up a bit and should show you where you are even in joining tunnels between acts (After bosses).[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips are no longer visible through unexplored areas on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Constant rage has been limited to 1 per deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Spring into action Foresight  was drawing Fly kicks and no other cards. Resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved Gloom bleeding into world when Gloom door opened[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes the Door lights in some dark tunnels[/p][/*][*][p]MegaShroom evolution bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Card icon placement bug fixed (mostly noticeable during a card evolution)[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu now displays in deck view.[/p][/*][*][p]Tasty pick and others that are created during combat will be drawn in as currency in shops[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where consuming 1 card on a stack would sometimes consume the entire stack.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Gloom Worm song! Still a work in progress, but makes the fight way more epic![/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects in the house![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Did you read all that? High fives - you're awesome!
[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/a18d8f9d74d4e39a2c01828e59fb0e93510422df.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: We’ve added flies and spiders!
Mega environmental improvements across all tunnels. Includes improved lighting, post processing, new mushrooms!
Gloom World glow up! Enjoy even more crystalized eye candy if you can beat the demo!
New doors and door frames leading into special environments (mossy, thorny or trippy). Enjoy clearer choices while exploring!
New biome-specific plinths for deploying your camp structures on!
Mega re-design of card UI.
Card descriptions separated based on when a card behavior will take effect (activated, triggered or passive). Added icons to make this clear.
Custom card bases to indicate deck type (combat, explore, curse, forsight or shroom)
Custom banners to indicate card classes (attack, skill, search, food, passive, curse or foresight)
Card status (like evolve, uses or battery) moved from bottom of card to little scrolls, in the top right.
Targeting pips on top of cards to indicate if they will effect 1 enemy, all enemies, 1 card, all cards in hand or the player.
Unique "toppings" for cards that can only be found in specific biomes (mossy or thorny)
Card artworks now dynamic. Will reposition if extra rules are added to cards by players.

In addition to the description being split into 3, cards should now better adjust layout as they grow, without text going off the edge of the card. (it's still possible, but we are not sure if it’s realistic to do it in a single run.)
Small change to the cost of a card in a shop, showing it in the top right.
Major rework to how cards behave in the players hand.
Cards lift to the bottom of the screen when being cast and to an equal height when highlighted.
Improved deck view, which allows you to toggle between draw pile and all cards!

tags.bug: The map has been fixed up a bit and should show you where you are even in joining tunnels between acts (After bosses).
Tooltips are no longer visible through unexplored areas on the map.

tags.balance_change: Constant rage has been limited to 1 per deck.

tags.bug: Spring into action Foresight	 was drawing Fly kicks and no other cards. Resolved.
Resolved Gloom bleeding into world when Gloom door opened
Fixes the Door lights in some dark tunnels
MegaShroom evolution bug fixed
Card icon placement bug fixed (mostly noticeable during a card evolution)
Pause menu now displays in deck view.
Tasty pick and others that are created during combat will be drawn in as currency in shops
Fixed an issue where consuming 1 card on a stack would sometimes consume the entire stack.

tags.feature: New Gloom Worm song! Still a work in progress, but makes the fight way more epic!
New sound effects in the house!

notes.title: 2 months of demo updates lead to this! Shroom and Gloom 0.4.71 is here!
notes.content:
[p][b]Yo Shroomers![/b]  

Ben from Team Lazerbeam here, checking in with the [b]July Dev Log[/b] for our [b]first person, roguelike double-deckbuilder, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602770/Shroom_and_Gloom_Demo/"]Shroom and Gloom![/url][/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602770/Shroom_and_Gloom_Demo/"]  [/url] It’s been a wild 2 months for Team Lazerbeam since we dropped our demo on Steam.   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/900142b2ee6a64613526390f8520385bec0a3e8e.png"][/img]  [/p][p]We were blown away by the overwhelming response to the demo - we were so stoked to see so many people trying out this early demo for Shroom and Gloom! Between Steam reviews, community discussions, lets plays, streams and posts on our Discord, we received mountains of feedback on the demo. Aside from giving us heaps of encouragement, this feedback highlighted many aspects of the demo that could be better. Over these past 2 months we’ve relentlessly been improving on the demo, and rolling out regular updates.    Today we're very happy to announce the launch of Shroom and Gloom 0.4.71, our latest demo update, and [b]likely the last one we’ll sharing for the next while.[/b]   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/afb2d06aef9e94d323efc3c16954a57d2c7dd401.jpg"][/img]
  0.4.71 is the last in a string of updates that have dropped since we put out our June Dev log. Curious about what’s changed? We’re share a list of highlights at the end of this dev log, but the TL:DR is that we’ve focused on improving three things. First, we’ve aimed to significantly improve the user experience of our core cardplay, particularly how players are able to navigate huge hands of cards (an essential in a game with no cap on how many cards you can hold). Second, we’ve poured tones of energy into improving our final boss fight, the nightmarish Gloom Worm. Lastly, we’ve done a deep dive on giving the games visuals an additional layer of love, particularly on the look of our levels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/7aa26a8f7450f825b843549f14e5cd01b0e43e84.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While we could easily keep updating this demo for another 2 months, we’re very stoked to be in a place where we can happily put a bow on this thing for now. We’ve addressed the biggest issues and requests from players. We’ve made the demo far more fun, immersive and stable in the process. And best of all, we have an even better idea of how to deliver on our goal of delivering the most immersive, inventive and dazzling new game in the deck builder genre.   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/6c2b469baf4f82d538c1b8a740455313208a5e05.jpg"][/img]
Infinite thanks and high fives to everyone that’s been part of this journey over the last 2 months. Thanks to everyone that picked up the demo, left a review or shared the game with their friends, family or communities. Thanks to anyone that joined our Discord, logged bugs, engaged in conversations or shared feedback. Thanks to everyone that’s inspired us to keep making Shroom and Gloom the best game it can be.  

We’ll keep in touch with how we’re progressing with developing this lovely game. If you would like to keep up with us between dev logs, follow us on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@teamlazerbeam"]TikTok[/url] or [url="https://www.instagram.com/teamlazerbeam/"]Instagram[/url] or [url=" https://www.youtube.com/@TeamLazerbeam"]Youtube[/url], join our [url=" https://www.teamlazerbeam.com/subscribe"]monthly mailer[/url], or hang out with us on [url="https://discord.gg/ZZspguu7Vu"]Discord[/url]. 

 Thanks again!
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/ff9dc4d39726577af31ddfd20ba22b553344d3dd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/fcdd7f9a06578dc58938cdde820acfe144edeebd.jpg"][/img]  [b]Mega list of change from the last month of updates to Shroom and Gloom[/b]:  

[b]0.4.71 (Steam demo 11) - 8 July[/b][/p][p]* Art: huge amount of visual improvements across various levels.[/p][p]* Gloom Worm gameplay: Changed when Cosmic Horror will increase costs (food and curses no longer trigger it. Changed how Inescapable rule works (Cosmic Horror now added to the top of your deck rather than being auto drawn)[/p][p]* Gloom Worm visuals: Improved UI layout on Gloomworm. Added more illustrated an animated elements.[/p][p]* Fixes:[/p][p]    * Fixed wrong return damage on hovering card[/p][p]    * Can't use a stacked toasty kebab to buy cards at the shop[/p][p]    * Fixed a bug where starting combat deck was thinning out after the first combat[/p][p]    * All soups can now be used as currency at shops[/p][p]    * Stopped Buttdoor from loading a new tunnel more than once[/p][p]    * Hard-coded that the player can never have less than 0 energy[/p][p]    * Fixed multiple add card to hand intents with different cards not displaying correctly.[/p][p]    * Fixed when adding a new trigger that adds cards on a card that already has at least one of those triggers, not actually adding the new cards, but just increasing the existing trigger's card count. (It now actually adds a new add card intent with the correct card)[/p][p]    * Made gloom worm face no longer jump on evolution.[/p][p]    * Various card tweaks and improvements
[/p][p][b]0.4.70 (Steam demo 10) - 4 July[/b][/p][p]* Cosmic Horror added to the Gloom Worm boss fight! Yipes![/p][p]* Guts added to Gloom Worm limbs. Yum![/p][p]* Gloom worm glow up[/p][p]    * New animations[/p][p]    * New art[/p][p]    * New layout[/p][p]    * ​​2 Exploding blossoms replacing 4 blossoms on first evolution[/p][p]* Stacking changes:[/p][p]    * All identical cards can now stack if you have a large hand[/p][p]    * Fixed that most consumables didn't stack-  i.e. stone picks now stack[/p][p]    * Fixed that an entire stack would take on the setting of the main card[/p][p]    * Cards with different Modifications won’t stack[/p][p]    * Cards in stacks are properly discarded and exhausted, then re-enter your deck[/p][p]* Environment glow up:[/p][p]    * General polishing and tightening of tunnels[/p][p]    * Beginning to implement bespoke mini-boss environments[/p][p]    * New tunnel colour gradients & lighting (earlier tunnels, currently in progress)[/p][p]    * Gloom Worm’s den looks more awesome.[/p][p]    * Gloom world looks more awesome.[/p][p]* Fixes:[/p][p]    * Fixed card descriptions, line breaks and italics[/p][p]    * When a card increases max health negatively, it now says "Decrease max health by"[/p][p]    * New Lazarus will always bring you back on a new turn, with a fresh hand.[/p][p]    * Burrows and enemies hide when dead[/p][p]    * Wrecking Ball draw a card[/p][p]    * Sneaky mole will look at all your picks as currency[/p][p]    * A locked card in soup pot will show its energy requirement[/p][p]    * Soup pot shows card values for easier cooking[/p][p]    * Cards are sorted in your hand according to type - 1) Handy 2) Passives 3) Skills 4) Attacks 5) Foods 6) Curses 
[/p][p][b]0.4.67 (Steam demo 9)[/b][/p][p]*  Attacks cary over on evolving enemies (So for example hot poker attacks will carry over). Statuses do not.[/p][p]* There is some more feedback and timing has been worked on during evolution.[/p][p]* Gloom worm changes[/p][p]    * Limbs apply vulnerable on the main body on death[/p][p]    * There are a number of intent changes to make the gloom worm fight a bit less overwhelming.[/p][p]    * Animations and VFX have been updated.[/p][p]    * There are some WIP lighting changes in the gloom worm tunnel and fight[/p][p]* Deck randomization has been improved, you should not draw cards in the same order that you see them in the deck view.[/p][p]* Tooltips for enemy intents and statuses have been improved (they now give a bit more information on what they apply to)[/p][p]* Flykick no longer removes status effects, and acacia mace has been removed from the card pool. This is in response to people getting confused, or disliking that statuses that are good for the player are removed.[/p][p]* Camp structures can no longer draw evolve cards, or cards with limited uses.[/p][p]* Text that is hovered to see a tooltip has an outline so it doesn't blend into cards that are the same color. [/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: * Fixed wrong return damage on hovering card
* Can't use a stacked toasty kebab to buy cards at the shop
* Fixed a bug where starting combat deck was thinning out after the first combat
* All soups can now be used as currency at shops
* Stopped Buttdoor from loading a new tunnel more than once
* Hard-coded that the player can never have less than 0 energy
* Fixed multiple add card to hand intents with different cards not displaying correctly.

* Fixed when adding a new trigger that adds cards on a card that already has at least one of those triggers, not actually adding the new cards, but just increasing the existing trigger's card count. (It now actually adds a new add card intent with the correct card)
* Made gloom worm face no longer jump on evolution.
* Various card tweaks and improvements
* Fixed card descriptions, line breaks and italics
* When a card increases max health negatively, it now says "Decrease max health by"
* New Lazarus will always bring you back on a new turn, with a fresh hand.
* Burrows and enemies hide when dead
* Wrecking Ball draw a card
* Sneaky mole will look at all your picks as currency
* A locked card in soup pot will show its energy requirement
* Soup pot shows card values for easier cooking
* Cards are sorted in your hand according to type - 1) Handy 2) Passives 3) Skills 4) Attacks 5) Foods 6) Curses

tags.balance_change: * Attacks cary over on evolving enemies (So for example hot poker attacks will carry over). Statuses do not.
* There is some more feedback and timing has been worked on during evolution.
* Limbs apply vulnerable on the main body on death
* There are a number of intent changes to make the gloom worm fight a bit less overwhelming.
* Animations and VFX have been updated.
* There are some WIP lighting changes in the gloom worm tunnel and fight
* Deck randomization has been improved, you should not draw cards in the same order that you see them in the deck view.
* Tooltips for enemy intents and statuses have been improved (they now give a bit more information on what they apply to)

* Flykick no longer removes status effects, and acacia mace has been removed from the card pool. This is in response to people getting confused, or disliking that statuses that are good for the player are removed.
* Camp structures can no longer draw evolve cards, or cards with limited uses.
* Text that is hovered to see a tooltip has an outline so it doesn't blend into cards that are the same color.

* Gloom Worm gameplay: Changed when Cosmic Horror will increase costs (food and curses no longer trigger it. Changed how Inescapable rule works (Cosmic Horror now added to the top of your deck rather than being auto drawn)
* Gloom Worm visuals: Improved UI layout on Gloomworm. Added more illustrated an animated elements.

tags.feature: * Art: huge amount of visual improvements across various levels.
* Cosmic Horror added to the Gloom Worm boss fight! Yipes!
* Guts added to Gloom Worm limbs. Yum!
* Gloom worm glow up
* New animations
* New art
* New layout

tags.balance_change: * ​​2 Exploding blossoms replacing 4 blossoms on first evolution
* Stacking changes:
* All identical cards can now stack if you have a large hand
* Fixed that most consumables didn't stack- i.e. stone picks now stack
* Fixed that an entire stack would take on the setting of the main card
* Cards with different Modifications won’t stack
* Cards in stacks are properly discarded and exhausted, then re-enter your deck

tags.feature: * Environment glow up:
* General polishing and tightening of tunnels
* Beginning to implement bespoke mini-boss environments
* New tunnel colour gradients & lighting (earlier tunnels, currently in progress)
* Gloom Worm’s den looks more awesome.
* Gloom world looks more awesome.

notes.title: Shroom and Gloom bursts into Turn Based Fest with monsterous update!
notes.content:
[p]Yo Shroomers!

We're delighted to be checking back in with a fresh blast of radical news from your favourite shroom-slinging game band, Team Lazerbeam!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/49ff0ad726d7441b5f3bb9e3046c0ea6031256c3.png"][/img]
It's our great pleasure to share that our game [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602770/Shroom_and_Gloom_Demo/"]Shroom and Gloom[/url] is a part of the incredible [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/turnbasedthursdayfest2025"]Turn Based Fest[/url]![/b] From 2-9 June. Turn Based Fest will be celebrating the wide world of wonderfully tactical turn based games. We're so honoured to have our first person roguelike double deckbuilder in the exceptional lineup of this years festival. To celebrate, w[b]e've just dropped a mega update to our free demo[/b]. This is our first update in 2 weeks, and it's bursting with awesome new content and quality of life improvements.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/027db36a304806e382c2c9e7bf0fa42687087173.png"][/img]

[b]So what's changed in the update? Let's dig into it![/b]

This update is largely the product of our continued efforts to work with our wonderful community (AKA The Gloom Patrol). Our community has been incredibly supportive and generous with their time and energy, sharing their thoughts and insights into how they're enjoying this early prototype of Shroom and Gloom. Based on community feedback (and our own lengthy to do lists) we've crammed a whole bunch of exciting improvements and additions into the demo. [b]Here's a short list of highlights![/b]
[/p][list][*][p]A bunch of new new cards have been added to the combat deck! Hollow Hamster hoards food in exchange for card draw. Flambé cooks up Gourmet Toasties that restore HP and energy! We leave it to you to discover what you can do with Rumbly Tummy, Self Loathing, Grand Maul, Absorb, Cravings and Satisfying Nibble, Dread and Relief![/p][/*][*][p]2 new camp structures added so you can modify your cards in explore phases! Use the kitchen to create even more powerful cooking synergies! Use the book shelf to [i]learn something[/i]![/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Wrecking Ball" card to clear campsites for even more upgrading while exploring![/p][/*][*][p]Heaps of lovely art updates to make cards more distinctive![/p][/*][*][p]Card reward options refined across entire game. [/p][/*][*][p]Shop offerings updated from 3 to 4 card choices[/p][/*][*][p]Major user experience improvements to how cards are handled in the player's hand. Still got some work to do here, but holding and playing cards feels much better. Especially improved the experience of having a massive hand of 10+ cards![/p][/*][*][p]Major performance improvements and reduced memory usage![/p][/*][*][p]Build size reduced by more than 60%![/p][/*][*][p]Added camera offsets to encounters so that framing is more centered.[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility features: sliders to reduce or disable camera bob or screen shake.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now move backwards to the start of the current tunnel, always.[/p][/*][*][p]Twinkies are Tinkies now![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620440/0875f7e4a5e5860e46296a02bba19f5ec94b9506.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our infinite thanks to all the community members who helped shape these updates. We're eternally grateful to everyone that's been playing the game, sharing bugs or leaving reviews on the demo!

That's all from us for now! If you've not yet checked it out, be sure to check out the Shroom and Gloom demo, wishlist the game, or come hang out with us on Discord!

Stay rad everybody!
<3 Team Lazerbeam
